long_biography.plain_text:
Singaporean investor Lee Thor Seng combined company ownership with direct involvement in property transactions. While serving as a director of Kluang Rubber, he was entitled to commissions for land disposals. He also held interests in the estate agency and administration companies that supplied services to the business.

Outside his corporate holdings, Lee was the last private owner of House No. 1 on Pulau Ubin, now a public heritage building. He was a close friend of architect James Ferrie, whose son visited the house while growing up. The government acquired the property in the 1990s; its subsequent restoration was a public project.
